replication.target_description: Relationship between objects' edibility and positive valence ratings, comparing low-calorie food with non-edible objects. Low-calorie food is specified, but non-edible objects could mean office tools or balls, which are separately analysed categories. The office contrast cannot establish a pooled non-edible contrast or the ball contrast.

n.sample_role: Candidate abstract count: 27 participants; target-test analytic inclusion unresolved.
n.exclusions: Excerpt reports 14.2 % erroneous trials, 3.3 % early movements and 2.5 SD outlier correction (1.83 % onset, 2.53 % contact, 2.57 % collection); one additional session cancelled. No N derived from these percentages or df.
